story.text: At the entrance of the garden, three {GARDENERS}, flat and oblong like playing {CARDS}, are busily painting the {WHITE} {ROSES} red. They planted a white rose-tree by {MISTAKE}, and if the Queen finds out, they will all have their {HEADS} cut off. Then one cries, “The Queen!”, and they throw themselves {FLAT} upon their faces.
story.caption: Painting the roses red
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
